# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old (when adopting Anne)  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking personage with an ungainly figure and stooping shoulders. He had long, iron-gray hair that touched his shoulders and wore a full, soft brown beard since he was twenty years old. Except for a bit of grayness, he looked much the same at sixty as he did at twenty.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Extremely shy and bashful, Matthew hated being among strangers or placed in situations where he had to talk. He was quiet, patient, wise, and a remarkably sympathetic listener who liked talkative people as long as they did not expect him to speak. He possessed a silent, stubborn persistency when clinging to his opinions and was quietly indulgent toward Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c13 P6](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0006), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived a quiet, retired life at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. Deciding to adopt a young orphan boy to help him with farm chores in his older years, Matthew drove to Bright River station, only to find Anne Shirley waiting instead. Despite his dread of little girls, Matthew was quickly won over by Anne's lively chatter and silently insisted on keeping her. Over the years, he formed a deep bond with Anne as her quiet champion, buying her a pretty dress for a school concert and giving her a little calf of her own. As his heart trouble worsened, he continued to work despite warnings. Upon receiving news of the failure of the Abbey Bank, Matthew suffered a fatal heart attack and died instantly on the doorstep of Green Gables. He was buried in the Avonlea graveyard, where Anne regularly visited his grave.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v2 c1 P16](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0016), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v4 c3 P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_
